title: Push in
summary: One word or the wordmark and a slow push of the camera onto it, the field sliding slower behind; a small line lands as it stops, in 4 s.

params.name: word
params.description: the word; empty takes the brand's name

params.name: line
params.description: a small line that lands as the push stops

params.name: closeness
params.description: where the push stops: 1 fills the frame, 0.5 leaves air

params.name: background
params.description: a background id from the registry; empty uses the brand's first

usage:
npx paper-motion add push-in --name my-shot
# edit CONFIG in pieces/my-shot/scene.html, then:
npx paper-motion render pieces/my-shot/scene.html --motion-blur 6
notes: Wired to the brand folder: needs brand/tokens.json (a palette and a font pair work) and, for the field, a shader-set entry.
Parallax comes from the field scaling slower than the camera approaches.

beats.name: Far
beats.what: the word small in the distance

beats.name: Push
beats.what: the camera pushes in; the field lags

beats.name: Hold
beats.what: the word holds; the line lands

when: the opening of a piece on the name
one word that deserves the whole frame
